title: SIA: Enhancing Safety via Intent Awareness for Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating safety rates (100 - attack success rate) via an LLM judge (GPT-4o-mini) on the 'discrimination & stereotyping' subset of the SIUO (Safe Image + Safe Text -> Unsafe Output) multimodal safety benchmark.
Evaluating safety rates via an LLM judge on the 'controversial topics, politics' category of the SIUO benchmark, testing the model's response to politically charged imagery and questions.
Evaluating safety rates via an LLM judge on the 'religion belief' category of the SIUO benchmark to measure the model's resistance to generating unsafe or harmful outputs regarding religious topics.
Using few-shot intent inference examples to check if models output biased information or stereotyping when prompted with cultural elements (e.g., culturally diverse food).
